description: Reference package for checking whether LLM-generated Korean legal citations exist and match official law text. Not runtime-enabled.

required_credentials.description: National Law Information Center open API key, when using a direct or self-hosted Korean Law MCP path.
Approved Korean Law MCP endpoint. Must be reviewed before App Store runtime use.

failure_modes.message: The cited law, article, paragraph, or item was not found in official source data.
The citation exists but law name, article, paragraph, item, or effective date does not match.
Citation verification lacks official source metadata.
Korean Law MCP or upstream law API is unavailable.

rules: Verify that the cited law text actually exists.
Show law name, article, paragraph, item, effective date, and mismatch details.
Mark verification failure as failed, not partial.
Do not present legal output as attorney advice.
Prefer official National Law Information Center or Ministry of Government Legislation sources.
Do not expose externalMCP as App Store runtime until separately approved.
